title: Android System Update
description:
This software update will upgrade your Android One to Android 7.0 Nougat. Multitask with ease with multi-window, bring your words to life with all-new emoji, and enjoy longer-lasting battery. Learn more at android.com/nougat.

This update includes the 2016-08 security patches. Future security updates may be downloaded and installed automatically, possibly using cellular data. Downloading updates over a cellular network or while roaming may cause additional charges.
